api_name: Open Targets GraphQL & REST API Beta
brain_biosamples_allowlist: C1 segment of cervical spinal cord

brain_reviewed_exclusions.pituitary gland: endocrine gland; anterior lobe is epithelial, not neural tissue

notes: Target.credibleSets accepts only `page`; all study-type and tissue filtering is client-side.
Target.credibleSets returns only molecular-QTL credible sets, never GWAS credible sets.
No h0/h1/h2 fields exist on Colocalisation in this API version.
query_status 'ok' with n_coloc=0 means measured zero; blank counts mean not measured.
